long_description:
Lights, music, dance & culture! Live Bollywood dancers, buffet, appetizers and a drink included. Bollywood attire encouraged.

About this Event

Join us at Bombay Bar & Grill in Midtown Sacramento for an unforgettable Bollywood Night celebrating Diwali, the Festival of Lights!

Enjoy an evening of lights, music, dance and culture with live Bollywood dancers, festive decor and the authentic Indian flavors Bombay Bar & Grill is known for.

Your $40 ticket includes:
Buffet / appetizersOne drink (beer, wine or well)Live Bollywood dancer performancesBollywood attire is encouraged, so dress up and come celebrate with us!

Refund policy: Refunds are available up to 5 days before the event and will be issued to the original payment method. Ticketing fees are non-refundable.
